items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: And then, while I was there at the same time, what's his name, Dude...

ctx.x: He would! He was a nice guy, but he didn't play. You know, he was one of them kinds you don't play with. But he'd shoot you in a minute. But he was a nice guy. I can't think of his name. He was a small guy.

And then, while I was there at the same time, what's his name, Dude... Not Dude Adams? Adams, a tenor player... Do you remember Adams? He was a big guy; a big, round(?) guy. And he used to play tenor and pound his feet, and he looked real terrible sitting up there on the bandstand. His name was Adams, but what his first name was I don't know. He could blow loud and look ugly and (?). He stayed a while...
Who replaced George Howe? Did Barbarin come in to replace Howe?
